+    def _resolve_option_name(self, name: str) -> str:
+        """Turn an option flag such as ``--count`` or ``-c`` into the name

+    ) -> None:
+        """Append a value of a parameter to its history. Does nothing when
+        tracking is off. Every entry after the first also holds the value
+        it replaced as ``previous_value``.
+        """
+        if not self._track_changes:
+            return

+        # Imported here because importing click must not import time.
+        import time
+
+        history = self._option_history.setdefault(name, [])
+        entry: dict[str, t.Any] = {

+            "source": source,
+            "timestamp": time.time(),

+            entry["previous_value"] = history[-1]["value"]
+
+        history.append(entry)
+
+    def get_option_history(self, name: str) -> list[dict[str, t.Any]] | None:
+        """Get the history of the values an option was given while this
+        context's command was parsed. This is only recorded for commands
+        created with ``track_changes=True``.
+
+        Each entry is a dict with the ``value``, the ``source`` as a
+        :class:`~click.core.ParameterSource`, and the ``timestamp`` from
+        :func:`time.time`. An entry that replaced an earlier value also has
+        that value as ``previous_value``. Entries are ordered oldest first.

+        :return: The list of entries, an empty list if the option has no
+            history, or ``None`` if tracking is not enabled.
+
+        .. versionadded:: 8.3
+        """

+            return None
+
+        return list(self._option_history.get(self._resolve_option_name(name), ()))
